items.title: Remove green waste from municipal land
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for compliance: 20.01.2026. No period to count, no delivery-fiction needed since a concrete date is printed. Due date is simply 2026-01-20 (a Tuesday, not a weekend/holiday, so no shift applies).

items.title: File Klage with the Verwaltungsgericht (no prior Widerspruch needed)
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 23.12.2025, sent by ordinary post from an authority (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG): counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Sat 27.12.2025 (this deemed-delivery day does not shift for weekends). The one-month Klage period (§ 74 VwGO) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 27.01.2026, a Tuesday, which is a working day, so no further shift is needed. Confirmed via the deadline tool.

warnings: The €480.00 mentioned is only the city's estimated cost of a substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) it threatens to carry out and bill later if the deadline is missed — it is not a current invoice or payment due now.

This letter announces direct Klage with no prior Widerspruch (Vorverfahren entfällt); given the one-month court deadline, get advice (e.g. a lawyer or Verbraucherzentrale) well before 2026-01-27 if you intend to contest it.

The IBAN printed (DE70 4405 0199 0001 0001 00) is well-formed and domestic (Sparkasse Musterstadt), but no payment is actually due from this letter — do not use it for any payment unless a separate invoice/Bescheid for Ersatzvornahme costs arrives.
